Chapter 1: Origins
1.1 Financial Crisis
The French monarchy faced bankruptcy after costly wars, forcing heavy new taxes on the population.1.2 Estates General
The Estates General convened in 1789 to address the crisis and soon became the National Assembly.Chapter 2: Revolution
2.1 Storming Of The Bastille
On 14 July 1789 crowds stormed the Bastille, a turning point that ignited the revolution.
